treaty_name: Agreement between the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and the Republic of Cyprus for the avoidance of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1985), applied by Montenegro
eif_quote: [CY MLI] Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (Montenegro) Original 29-06-1985 08-09-1986 || [ME PU table] 17 | Kipar | dohodak i imovinu | SFRJ 2/86 | 1.1.1987. || Art. 27(2): "Ugovor stupa na snagu na dan razmene instrumenata ratifikacije, a njegove odredbe primenjuju se u odnosu na poreze na dohodak i na imovinu za svaku poresku godinu koja počinje prvog januara ili posle prvog januara kalendarske godine koja sledi godinu u kojoj je izvršena razmena instrumenata ratifikacije."
source_title: Ugovor SFRJ-Kipar, "Službeni list SFRJ - Međunarodni ugovori" br. 2/86, Serbo-Croatian text as published by the Montenegrin Ministry of Finance (authentic text: English only)

rates.quote: 2. Međutim, takve dividende mogu se oporezivati i u državi ugovornici čiji je rezident društvo koje isplaćuje dividende, u skladu sa zakonima te države, ali tako razrezan porez ne može preći 10 odsto od bruto iznosa dividendi.
2. Kamata iz stava 1. ovog člana može biti oporezivana i u državi ugovornici u kojoj nastaje, u skladu sa zakonima te države, ali tako razrezan porez ne može preći 10 odsto od bruto iznosa kamate.

2. Autorske naknade iz stava 1. ovog člana mogu se oporezivati i u državi ugovornici u kojoj nastaju, u skladu sa zakonima te države, ali tako razrezan porez ne može preći 10 odsto od bruto iznosa autorskih naknada.

ppt.quote: [MLI Art. 7(1)] Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Succession: concluded by the SFR Yugoslavia (Nicosia, 29-06-1985; Sl. list SFRJ - MU 2/86); continued by Montenegro as a successor State (Montenegrin MoF list and Poreska uprava table; Cyprus lists it in its MLI position as "Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (Montenegro)"). Art. 10(3) (unnumbered paragraph in the published text): as long as Cyprus does not impose a tax on dividends in addition to the tax on company profits, dividends paid by a Cypriot company to a resident of Yugoslavia are exempt from any Cypriot tax chargeable on dividends in addition to the company tax - conditional one-way exemption, not modelled as a tier. No beneficial-owner wording in Arts. 10-12 (rate limits apply to the recipient). Authentic text is English only; the official Serbo-Croatian translation was read (English original not obtained). MLI: both list the treaty, WHT effect 2027-01-01 per map.json; MLI Art. 8 not relevant (single dividend rate).
unverified: English authentic text not read; values from the official Yugoslav-gazette translation published by the Montenegrin MoF
